item.title: 'Fight goes on’: 87-yr-old woman dies after becoming symbol of Spain housing crisis
item.description: María del Carmen Abascal, known as Maricarmen, died in a hospital after being evicted from her home. Her eviction triggered nationwide protests highlighting the housing crisis afflicting Spain. Activists voiced anger over Maricarmen's death as a symbol of the struggle against rising rents and evictions. Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez offered condolences, acknowledging the impact of her case on public sentiment.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: UK's oldest Indian restaurant owner accuses Crown Estate of not valuing curry traditions
item.description: Ranjit Mathrani, the owner of Veeraswamy, is taking legal action against the Crown Estate over lease refusal. He believes this reflects an undervaluation of Indian culinary traditions compared to European cuisine. The restaurant has a significant historical background with notable patrons, including Indian leaders. The Crown Estate maintains its decision is based on structural issues and not culinary bias.
item.dc:creator: Naomi Canton

item.title: FBI foils alleged ISIS-linked attack plot at Mall of America by 18-year-old
item.description: Sheikhdoon Abdullahi Mohamud, an 18-year-old, was arrested for planning an attack on the Mall of America. He agreed to buy an AK-47 and ammunition from an undercover FBI agent posing as an ISIS member. Mohamud expressed intentions to kill non-Muslims during a scheduled Hmong arts celebration. US authorities stated that his radicalization was identified well before his plan could be executed.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: Chicago’s vacant LeClaire Courts site set for $127M redevelopment with 183 homes in first phase
item.description: The Chicago city council has recently granted approval for redevelopment plans at the LeClaire Courts site. The initial phase will feature two six-story buildings containing 183 apartments and a childcare facility, with approximately 90 percent of the units designated for low-income households. Set to begin construction in late 2026, this project aims to breathe new life into the area, fostering community and connectivity where it has long been absent.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Sandra Bullock’s 91-acre California ranch with 1,200 avocado trees sells for $5.6M
item.description: In 2007, Sandra Bullock acquired a sprawling 91-acre ranch in Valley Center for $2.725 million. After transforming it with extensive renovations and establishing an organic avocado farm, she sold the property for $5.6 million in 2024. Encompassing a beautifully refurbished adobe house, a guest cottage, and facilities for agricultural operations, the ranch stands as a perfect blend of luxury and sustainability for its future owner.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: Sharks’ Long-Range Hearing: Study finds 74m sound detection; sharks turn away
item.description: A team of researchers from Florida Atlantic University discovered that wild blacktip sharks possess the ability to detect low-frequency sounds from considerable distances. This groundbreaking study sheds light on how these sharks navigate their aquatic environments, as they exhibited keen directional hearing by making sharp turns in response to sound sources.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: Ricky Martin’s former Beverly Hills mansion sells for $35M
item.description: A luxurious Beverly Hills mansion was recently sold for $35 million after being on the market for four months. Originally listed at $75 million, the price was reduced significantly due to lack of buyers despite its celebrity ownership history. The estate features a main residence, a guest house, and various recreational amenities including a tennis court and children's playground.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: $1.50 thrifted clutch turns out to be Cartier; valued at $35,000 on Antiques Roadshow
item.description: A thrift-store shopper who paid just $1.50 for a clutch in 2018 or 2019 discovered years later that it was a rare Cartier Art Deco piece. During a 2026 "Antiques Roadshow" appraisal, experts identified precious stones, platinum and the Cartier name inside, valuing the purse at about $35,000, with an insurance value above $100,000.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Ellison Seeks Higher Price? Larry relists Seminole Beach estate for $165 million; potential record land sale
item.description: Larry Ellison is putting his North Palm Beach estate back on the market, initially acquired for $80 million, now with a hefty asking price of $165 million. Spanning 8.4 acres and featuring direct beachfront access within a gated community, the estate boasts luxurious amenities. Despite potential redevelopment plans, the existing home remains.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Dierlam V. Allegiant Resources: Texas court backs plug-well access; ranch rights dispute deepens
item.description: A Texas appeals court ruled that Allegiant Resources can access McFaddin Ranch to plug an inactive well. The dispute centers around the Remora Oil Unit No. 1 located near the San Antonio River. Virginia L. Dierlam, the ranch owner, previously secured a permanent injunction that limited access to the ranch. Allegiant argues that plugging the well is necessary to avoid environmental concerns, which the court acknowledged.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Texas ranch hit by wildfire returns for $180 million
item.description: Now listed for $180 million, Turkey Track Ranch encompasses 77,721 acres of breathtaking terrain. After rebounding from the Smokehouse Creek Fire, this property has rejuvenated its cattle operations and features nearly 26 miles of scenic Canadian River frontage, ensuring abundant water supply. With a lineage connected to essential battles and over a hundred years of family ownership, this sale is a unique opportunity to own a remarkable piece of history.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: State Road 11 Improvement Dispute: Indiana Supreme Court backs INDOT; trial court must enter $20,840 award
item.description: Transportation authorities in Indiana sought to acquire a section of Jeremy Willis's land for a project on State Road 11. An appraisal placed the property's value at $20,840, with no objections raised. The Indiana Supreme Court determined that the appraisal was final according to state law. Consequently, the trial court was directed to finalize the judgment and authorize the fund release.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Ken Griffin buys 30 acres in Miami’s Wynwood for $1.1 billion, plans university campus
item.description: Moishe Mana has finalized the impressive sale of his Mana Wynwood properties to Ken Griffin for around $1.1 billion. This pivotal transaction will enable the development of a Carnegie Mellon University campus in Wynwood, set to welcome over 3,500 students and nearly 300 faculty members once operational. Construction is anticipated to start in 2027, with plans for student recruitment in forthcoming years.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: Breaking Bad star Aaron Paul ditches LA for life in France, sells $7.495M home after year on market
item.description: Breaking Bad star Aaron Paul has sold his Los Angeles home, the historic Seyler House, for $7.495 million after more than a year on the market. The 4,026-square-foot Los Feliz property was initially listed for $10 million in July 2025 before its asking price was reduced to $8.2 million in January.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: Jim Belushi’s Oregon retreat grew to 93 acres with cows, calves and a sweat lodge
item.description: Jim Belushi has expanded his Oregon property from 13 acres to 93 acres, establishing a working ranch. The ranch serves as a spiritual sanctuary where he focuses on sobriety, family, and land stewardship. Belushi manages a herd of around 50 cows and 50 calves, emphasizing the ranch's working identity. His involvement in cannabis cultivation reflects a blend of business and lifestyle choices.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk
